meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交蛋白序列开展结合与稳定性实验,取回测定结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做蛋白工程实验,想要一套清晰的送检与结果获取指南。
copy.tagline_en: Submit protein sequences for binding and stability assays, then retrieve results.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按 Adaptyv Foundry API 和 Python SDK 的规则,帮你提交蛋白质序列、选择实验类型(如结合/热稳定)、估算费用、创建提交实验,并在约 21 天出具结果后获取数据。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Adaptyv”或“Foundry API”,要做蛋白质结合/热稳定性等实验或想提交序列做表征,或代码里出现 `adaptyv`/`FoundryClient` 导入时。

say.text: 帮我在 Adaptyv 上提交两个序列做结合筛选实验
say.note: Claude 会指导你创建实验并提交

say.text: 用 Python SDK 估算 PD-L1 筛选实验要多少钱
say.note: Claude 会给出 cost_estimate 请求代码

say.text: 查一下我上次提交的实验结果出来没有
say.note: Claude 会演示轮询状态并获取结果

howto.what_en: Claude can guide you through Adaptyv Bio Foundry API/SDK: submit sequences, pick experiment types, estimate costs, create and submit experiments, and retrieve results (~21 days).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says Adaptyv/Foundry API, wants a protein experiment (binding, thermostability, etc.) or sequence submission, or imports adaptyv/FoundryClient in code.

say_en.text: Help me submit two sequences for a binding screen on Adaptyv.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through creating and submitting via SDK.

say_en.text: Estimate the cost for a PD-L1 screening experiment using the Python SDK.
say_en.note: Claude will show the cost_estimate request.

say_en.text: Check whether my last experiment finished and pull the results.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate polling and get_results.
